title: Laptop failed patching
description: Laptop keeps rebooting after Windows patch installation
ai_summary: A laptop enters a repeated reboot cycle after installing Windows patches, preventing normal startup or stable use. The incident has moderate impact and urgency.
probable_cause: A failed, incompatible, or partially applied Windows update has left the operating system in an unstable state. Other possibilities include corrupted system files, an update conflict with a driver, or insufficient disk space during patch installation.
recommended_actions: Boot the laptop into Windows Recovery Environment or Safe Mode, review the update history and recent system changes, and uninstall the latest quality or feature update if the reboot loop began immediately afterward.
Run Startup Repair, then use System File Checker and DISM (for example, `sfc /scannow` and `DISM /Online /Cleanup-Image /RestoreHealth`) to repair corrupted Windows components.
Check available disk space and relevant Windows Update/System logs; if the issue persists, restore from a known-good restore point or reimage the laptop after confirming that user data is backed up.

title: User account locked
description: User cannot log in because the account is locked
ai_summary: A user is unable to log in because their account has been locked, preventing access to required systems or services. The impact is moderate and the issue is urgent.
probable_cause: Multiple unsuccessful login attempts, potentially caused by an incorrect password, an expired password, a saved outdated password on a device or application, or suspected unauthorized access.
recommended_actions: Verify the user’s identity and review authentication or directory logs to confirm the lockout source and timing.
Unlock the account through the approved identity-management or directory service, and reset the password if compromise or repeated failed attempts are suspected.
Check devices, email clients, VPNs, mobile apps, and mapped services for stored outdated credentials; update them and monitor for further lockouts.

title: VPN connection failed
description: User receives an authentication error when connecting to VPN
ai_summary: A user is unable to connect to the corporate VPN because the connection attempt returns an authentication error, preventing remote access to internal resources.
probable_cause: The most likely cause is invalid, expired, or locked user credentials, or a failure in the VPN’s MFA/authentication service.
recommended_actions: Verify the user’s VPN username and password, confirm the account is active and not locked, and reset the password if it is expired.
Confirm that MFA is functioning and that the user is approving the correct authentication prompt; check for VPN client or credential-cache issues.
Review VPN gateway and authentication-server logs for the failed attempt, then test connectivity with a known-good account or from another network to isolate a user, client, or service-side problem.
